analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, patches and base/head source. Changes are confined to test targets; no concrete security regression is established. StatusResidencyTests.swift:119-175 adds synthetic recovery diagnostics and saved-filter/start/switch comparison assertions. AutopilotPlacementFixture.swift:120-125 adds test-only resident-age and lease setters, not production control endpoints. SelectedModelRecoveryFixture.swift:11-25 substitutes stub loading and waits for recovery attempts.
SelectedModelPlacementPolicyTests.swift:16-100 asserts withdrawal of an expired adoption before eviction, completion of in-flight work, minimum dwell, and preservation of held/operator-selected models. SelectedModelRecoveryPolicyTests.swift:13-232 asserts idle hysteresis, hold protection, selection preservation, memory-only retries, serialization with other residency owners/live Autopilot control, and backoff capped at ten minutes. These address availability interactions at TB-002/TB-007 and T-010/T-029, but test assertions are not proof of production enforcement.
No supplied change modifies attestation, authorization, tokens, billing, encryption, media storage or T-041 cache scope/TTL/crypto. Production recovery and request-admission implementations are absent from this batch. Integration should verify that withdrawal blocks new/queued admissions while existing work drains, that asynchronous recovery rechecks competing residency ownership and selection changes, and that eviction preserves cache-budget/shutdown cleanup. Per-model lease protection is described in SelectedModelPlacementPolicyTests.swift:5-10 and enabled by the new setter, but is not exercised by the supplied placement tests. Reconcile these contracts against production changes in the next pass; missing source is a coverage limit, not a finding.
